question: Does removing the binary command contrast from the frozen H4 output interface selectively erase the predicted half-effect on both original and fresh-text populations, including simultaneous removal?

frozen_design.populations: Run every 128 endpoint in the original licensed bank and every 128 endpoint in the fresh temporal-v12/is-was-v16 bank. Preserve phases, templates, cells, and groups separately.
frozen_design.removal_semantics: At each command query and each H4 head slice, replace the native output with the arithmetic midpoint of the current endpoint and its exact command-counterfactual donor. Because pairing is involutive, paired endpoints must produce the same midpoint. Temporal-only, is-was-only, and both-removal arms are fixed; no zero baseline or fitted neutral state is introduced.
frozen_design.target: The prospective causal target is one half of the native paired command-margin difference. Score actual midpoint effects against that half-effect using canonical will-minus-had and is-minus-was margins.
frozen_design.single_removal_bars: For each population x phase, temporal signed recovery >=.80 and is-was >=.65 relative to the half-effect, cosine >=.98, direction agreement 1.0, and cross-role/gold norm <=.01. At least 75% of native-correct rows must reduce their correctness-aligned target margin. Later is-was removal must change the earlier temporal margin by <=1e-5.
frozen_design.joint_removal_bars: For every population x role x phase x template, interaction RMS / both-effect RMS <=.10 and additive cosine >=.99. Simultaneous signed recovery may be at most .05 below the corresponding single-removal recovery.

predictions.pred_a_authority_pairing_midpoint_invari: Both licensed results and builders are exact; pairing, positions, capture shapes, pairwise midpoint invariance, closure, finiteness, and literal price pass.
predictions.pred_b_h4_midpoint_selectively_removes_o: Every original-population phase passes the registered half-effect recovery, cosine, direction, margin-reduction, collateral, and causal-zero bars.
predictions.pred_c_h4_midpoint_selectively_removes_o: Every fresh-population phase passes the same registered bars without reselection.
predictions.pred_d_simultaneous_midpoint_removal_is_: All population/template composition and simultaneous-loss bars pass.

null: If A passes but B or C fails, donor-swap sufficiency does not establish selective necessity/removal for H4 on that population. If D fails, the two removals cannot be installed compositionally. Preserve the swap licenses but do not call H4 manipulable; do not tune a neutral point or subset after outcomes.
decision: A/B/C/D/E establishes a prospective selective edit of the H4 task-typed interface on original and OOD text. It opens extraction/price testing and L11 value source localization; it is not itself a standalone model replacement.
